boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented UNCW rituals and recurring campus events, from teal-wearing Tuesdays to the first-year class photo.

cards.title: Wear Teal on Tuesday
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide UNCW spirit tradition
cards.notes: Plan one teal item for Tuesday and join students, faculty and staff in displaying UNCW’s officially recognized primary color.
cards.short_summary: A weekly campus ritual centered on UNCW teal.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW identifies Teal Tuesday as a campus tradition in which students, faculty and staff display the school color.
cards.access_notes: Wear teal anywhere on campus on Tuesdays.

cards.title: Spot the Mace at Convocation
cards.subtitle: Formal academic ceremonies
cards.notes: At convocation or commencement, watch for the mace carried by the chief faculty marshal and notice its regional and university materials.
cards.short_summary: A ceremonial mace leads UNCW’s major academic observances.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW states that its mace is carried by the chief faculty marshal at commencement and convocation.
cards.access_notes: Observe during scheduled convocation or commencement ceremonies.

cards.title: Unveil the Class Flag
cards.subtitle: New-student convocation
cards.notes: New students can take part in the convocation flag unveiling, then use the class marker as a simple record of their entering cohort.
cards.short_summary: Each incoming class begins the year by unveiling its flag.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW says incoming freshmen unveil their class flag as part of the start-of-year tradition.
cards.access_notes: Participation is part of new-student convocation programming.

cards.title: Join the Giant Class Photo
cards.subtitle: New-student convocation
cards.notes: Arrive with your incoming class for the traditional class photo, a shared first-year moment held before the formal convocation program.
cards.short_summary: Incoming Seahawks gather for a cohort portrait at the academic year’s opening.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW documents a traditional class photo for incoming freshmen at the beginning of each academic year.

cards.title: Make the Trek to Trask
cards.subtitle: Trask Coliseum • new academic year
cards.notes: Follow the incoming class to Trask Coliseum for formal convocation and hear UNCW’s academic expectations from university leadership and faculty.
cards.short_summary: A collective walk to Trask marks the official opening of the year.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW says incoming freshmen make the trek to Trask Coliseum for the formal convocation ceremony.
cards.access_notes: For new students during the annual convocation program.

cards.title: Gather for Homecoming TEALgate
cards.subtitle: UNCW Homecoming
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming schedule, wear teal and take part in the family-oriented TEALgate gathering connected to the men’s basketball game.
cards.short_summary: Teal attire and basketball anchor UNCW’s Homecoming gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW lists Homecoming TEALgate and a men’s basketball game among its Homecoming traditions.
cards.access_notes: Occurs as part of the annual Homecoming schedule; confirm current event details.

cards.title: See Homecoming Royalty Announced
cards.subtitle: Men’s basketball halftime • Homecoming
cards.notes: Attend the Homecoming basketball game and watch halftime for the announcement of Homecoming royalty and recognition of alumni award winners.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming royalty is revealed at halftime of the men’s basketball game.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW states that Homecoming royalty is announced at halftime of the men’s basketball game.
cards.access_notes: Timing depends on the annual Homecoming basketball game.

cards.title: Start Homecoming Week at Late Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Wagoner Dining Hall • spring Homecoming Week
cards.notes: During spring Homecoming Week, head to Wagoner for the faculty-and-staff-served breakfast, Sammy photos and the annual Lip Sync Battle.
cards.short_summary: A breakfast gathering launches UNCW’s spring Homecoming Week.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW describes Late Night Breakfast as the kick-off to spring Homecoming Week, with breakfast served by faculty and staff.
cards.access_notes: UNCW labels the event “Late Night Breakfast”; verify the current Homecoming schedule and dining access before going.

cards.title: Share the Wagsgiving Meal
cards.subtitle: Wagoner Dining Hall • before Thanksgiving break
cards.notes: Before Thanksgiving break, look for UNCW’s Thanksgiving-themed Wagsgiving meal at Wagoner Dining Hall and confirm the dining schedule for the date.
cards.short_summary: A Thanksgiving-themed Wagoner meal sends students toward break.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW identifies Wagsgiving as a Thanksgiving-themed meal at Wagoner Dining Hall before Thanksgiving break.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the annual date and applicable dining access with UNCW Dining.

cards.title: Fall into the Dub
cards.subtitle: First semester • campus-wide welcome events
cards.notes: Use the first-semester Fall into the Dub calendar to sample welcome activities, meet student leaders and learn how to stay involved on campus.
cards.short_summary: A first-semester welcome series helps students connect with UNCW.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW describes Fall into the Dub as a move-in-to-first-semester series of events and activities welcoming students to the UNCW community.
cards.access_notes: Events occur throughout the first semester; consult the current campus calendar.
